ruleDefinitions.name: LSASS Memory Access by Tool With Dump Keyword In Name
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects LSASS process access requests from a source process with the "dump" keyword in its image name. Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, SourceImage, GrantedAccess

sequences.query: (TargetImage = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") AND SourceImage = RGX(".*dump.*") AND (GrantedAccess = RGX("10$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("30$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("50$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("70$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("90$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("B0$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("D0$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("F0$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("18$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("38$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("58$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("78$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("98$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("B8$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("D8$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("F8$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("1A$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("3A$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("5A$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("7A$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("9A$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("BA$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("DA$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("FA$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("0x14C2$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("FF$")))
